metadata.summary: Named typed probabilistic decisions over a bounded shared document, independent of the decision engine.

semantics.description: Evaluate once without thresholding, rounding, renormalization or idempotency promise. Normative proposed SEMANTICS.md defines decimal, correspondence, limits and conditional shape. Provider-reported confidence is metadata, not calibration.

evidence.conformance: conformance.json: parent-executed pinned Node24.21.0 16/16 tests, fixture/testkit only
evidence.implementation: services/decision/provider/{contract,decimal,neutral}.mjs; services/decision/service/index.mjs; exact parent-reviewed SHA256 records in conformance.json

proposal.abstraction: Single unary bounded evaluate on a shared structured state with named typed questions, resolved model, exact decimal uncertainty and generic token usage.
proposal.alternatives: Reuse Echo/Agent Execution rejected for semantic mismatch; provider-named capability rejected for coupling; adding floating point to frozen ACAP prohibited.
proposal.compatibility: New URI/identity, no changes to frozen entries or policies. Proposed namespace-policy release list empty pending independent maintainer review/admission.
proposal.existingInsufficient: Frozen Echo only round-trips text; Agent Execution runs agents and does not define decisions or fractional probability representation. Neither expresses named decision distributions.
proposal.genericRationale: Neutral implementation imports no TypeSafe code. Arbitrary explicit Score levels and typed fractional documents do not assume any provider wire schema. Engine adapters may reject unsupported rubrics explicitly.
proposal.problem: An external consumer needs typed probabilistic Boolean, Choice and Score decisions without an engine-specific protocol.
providers: TypeSafe Jev adapter (planned; public API0.2.0 pinned, not live-qualified)
proposal.scopes: application/session, operation evaluate, permission decision.evaluate, no new Kernel scope or grant type.
proposal.security: Host alone grants call authority; provider selected by host configuration, no request-side provider routing. Disable switch. No secrets/state/raw provider errors logged. All live work needs separate fixed durable aggregate ledger.

evidence.reference: Owner-authorized Phase4; actual independent parent.review.json (separate parent context, not human acceptance)

review.rationale: Actual parent source review of prepare.mjs, SEMANTICS.md, contract.mjs, decimal.mjs and service/index.mjs, frozen reviewProposal/transition rules, exact remote generated-file/source hashes and parent-executed pinned DEV16/16 tests. Abstraction: named Boolean/Choice/Score decisions have no fit in Echo or Agent Execution; new single unary capability is neutral, no TypeSafe imports in contract; exact decimal strings and bounded canonical Document envelope solve frozen ACAP constraints within Decision only. Explicit finite limits and provider unsupported-rubric rejection preserve semantics. Security: Host retains grant authority; provider configured outside request, one invocation, bounded deadline, disable switch, normalized errors without raw provider bodies. Scopes: uses existing application/session and evaluate operation; decision.evaluate is descriptive permission, not self-authority. Compatibility: new identity/version, closed bounded schema plus normative semantic validators, no frozen tracked diffs; no stable entries altered. Approve EXPERIMENTAL admission through actual frozen governance functions and a separate selected Phase4 snapshot under owner's explicit Phase4 implementation authorization; not STABLE promotion, production/security qualification or final release acceptance. Live/adapter/external criteria remain unfinished. Reviewer is a separate parent execution context, not an external human or owner acceptance. All current conformance evidence is fixture/testkit only.
